technical.summary: Bullish structure with three white soldiers and strong moving average alignment, but overbought oscillators, weak trend strength (ADX 12.64), and negative momentum divergence (AO negative, RSI 9 not rising) limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: CPRT shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 34 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 39.9% vs bullish 24%) with neutral fear-greed reading (56 = mild greed); insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (193.9) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 34 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + TEMA cross-up + price above major moving averages (50/200 SMA) provide classic bullish structure with OBV rising confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), negative Awesome Oscillator, weak ADX (12.64—no trend confirmation), zero fundamental conviction, and macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 193.9) create a high-risk, low-conviction setup with earnings event risk in 34 days.

decision.entry_rationale: Three white soldiers and TEMA cross-up provide bullish structure, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX (12.64) signal momentum exhaustion rather than trend confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 193.9) combined with earnings event risk in 34 days and zero fundamental conviction create asymmetric downside risk in a weakening market.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CPRT with 85 existing Industrials positions (15.7% sector concentration); adding would violate concentration limits and reduce conviction further.
